scope: Source-level timeout parity between the Python and JavaScript native Gateway clients.

finding.javascript_before_change: No request deadline; a stalled Fetch request could remain pending indefinitely.
finding.javascript_after_change: Defaults to timeoutMs=10000 and passes an AbortSignal to Fetch; callers can set a finite positive timeoutMs.

changes: Add a configurable JavaScript public API request deadline with a 10-second default matching Python.
Abort stalled Fetch requests and clear the deadline timer after completion.
Reject non-finite or non-positive timeoutMs values.
Document the default and override in the JavaScript SDK README.

javascript_public_api_tests.command: cd sdk/javascript && npx vitest run src/__tests__/public-api.test.ts

limitations: All requests were mocked; no Gateway, database, provider, or network call was made.
Custom fetch implementations must honor the supplied AbortSignal for the timeout to interrupt their pending operation.
